extracted.name: Chilaquiles
extracted.description: Look for unflavoured tortilla chips for this recipe and, if you have time, make the homemade smoky salsa, too – it makes this a special breakfast or brunch
ingredient_lines: 1 avocado peeled, halved, stone removed, diced
instruction_lines: Preheat the grill. To make the salsa, put the tomatoes (cut-side up), onion slices, jalapeños and garlic on a baking sheet lined with tin foil. Season with the salt and broil for 8 mins, or until everything is blackened. Transfer everything except the garlic to a blender or food processor with the chipotle, 230ml water, 1 tsp salt and the lime juice and coriander. Peel the garlic and add it to the blender or processor, and blend until smooth. Pour the mixture into a frying pan.
Turn the oven to 200C/gas 6 and put the tortilla chips on a baking sheet. Cook for 5 mins to warm through.

While the tortillas are baking, heat the vegetable oil in a frying pan over a high heat until very hot. Carefully crack in the eggs and cook sunny-side up until the egg white is solid. Season. Remove from heat and set aside.
Warm the pan of salsa over a low heat and add the tortilla chips. Gently toss until completely coated. Keep warm over a low heat.
To serve, divide the chilaquiles between four plates. Top each plate with an egg, some feta or queso fresco, coriander, avocado and red onion.
